name: Deconstruct Parameter
description: Deconstruct acoustic parameters. Connect the parameters of Analyse Impulse Response and choose on the body which to take: all of them (a branch each), or one by name (EDT, T20, T30, C50, C80, D50, DRR, Ts, STI, G), which gives it as a parameter for Plot 2D or a panel, and its name, values, frequencies and overall value as plain lists.

inputParameters.name: parameters
inputParameters.description: AcousticParameter (AP) objects, e.g. the parameters of Analyse Impulse Response.

outputParameters.name: parameter
outputParameters.description: The selected AcousticParameter (AP) object(s): connect Plot 2D to plot it, or a panel to print its values per band and overall value.

outputParameters.name: name
outputParameters.description: Name of the acoustic parameter (one per parameter when select is all).

outputParameters.name: values
outputParameters.description: Values of the acoustic parameter, one per frequency band (one branch per parameter when select is all).

outputParameters.name: overall
outputParameters.description: Overall value of the acoustic parameter (one per parameter when select is all).
